versos.e: 2. A son of Becher, grandson of Benjamin 1Ch 7:8
4. Son of Michael, and ruler of the tribe of Issachar during the time of David 1Ch 27:18
.Was commander of the army of Israel, and was proclaimed king by the army upon news of the assassination of King Elah 1Ki 16:16
.Defeats his rival, Tibni, and establishes himself 1Ki 16:17-22
